player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between Closet and Home theater, repeatedly going east and then west. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I decided to continue going back and forth instead of exploring other rooms. Next time, I will explore other rooms by going in the opposite direction of the current room. For example, if I'm in Closet, I will go west to Home theater, then I will go south to Garage, and so on. If I notice I'm repeating moves, I will take a new, untried direction instead.
